Rules
• 1 chapter = +30 Knowledge XP.
• Defeating a tome = completion XP and a phase-appropriate stat reward.
• Full daily clear = +60 bonus XP.
• 1 chapter on a busy day preserves momentum.
• 1 missed day has no penalty.
• Two consecutive no-reading days produce a gentle warning, not a punishment.
• No scientific claim is made by the fictional stats; they are game mechanics representing curriculum emphasis.
• Chapter totals are entered by you because editions can differ.
• If a tome has a total chapter count, the system can show when it is ready to be defeated.
